prompts.label: banner
prompts.text: A wide horizontal scene showing a split composition: on the left, a person's hands carefully wrapping a gift with colorful ribbon, with small thought bubbles floating above containing memories and brain imagery; on the right, a person receiving a gift but with faded, less prominent memory bubbles. The scene includes scattered gift boxes, ribbons, and small 3D-style brain icons floating around. Dimension ratio 16:9, size 1200px wide. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Use warm, vibrant pastels (teal #00A99D, coral-orange #FF6B35, sunshine yellow #FFD700). Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel cheerful, light, editorial, and creative — never realistic or photorealistic. Use text only in social images. Background colors can vary within our color palette.
